name: CC-4DGS Training Schedule and Hash Encoding Configuration
aliases: Canonical Deformation Field (CDF) with Compression (CCA) setup
definition: A training and encoding configuration for dynamic Gaussian splatting that replaces learnable XOR-based hash tables with modulation-based universal hash functions, dense hash encoding, and lightweight neural decoders, combined with a three-stage optimization schedule and dynamic-score gating.
summary: CC-4DGS is a dynamic Gaussian splatting configuration that reduces storage by replacing XOR-based hash tables with neural decoders and uses a three-stage schedule with dynamic-score gating to optimize efficiency and quality.
